notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 1 life this turn.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.
Junk Diver dies, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying at most {1}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
Myr Retriever dies, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Junk Diver by paying at most {2}.
